description: Unit tests for the CTLogVerifier class, including verification of Merkle tree proofs, consistency proofs, and SCT verification, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: CTLogVerifierTest
classes.description: Test fixture for CTLogVerifier, setting up a verifier instance.

classes.name: CTLogVerifierConsistencyProofTest
classes.description: Parameterized test for verifying consistency proofs.

classes.name: CTLogVerifierAuditProofTest
classes.description: Parameterized test for verifying audit proofs.

classes.name: CTLogVerifierTestUsingGenerator
classes.description: Parameterized test for generated Merkle trees and proofs.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the log_ verifier instance before each test.

methods.name: VerifyCertSCT
methods.description: Tests verification of a valid SCT for a certificate.

methods.name: VerifyPrecertSCT
methods.description: Tests verification of a valid SCT for a precertificate.

methods.name: FailsInvalidTimestamp
methods.description: Ensures verification fails if the SCT timestamp is invalid.

methods.name: FailsInvalidLogID
methods.description: Ensures verification fails if the log ID is mangled.

methods.name: VerifiesValidSTH
methods.description: Checks verification of a valid Signed Tree Head.

methods.name: DoesNotVerifyInvalidSTH
methods.description: Checks that verification fails for an invalid Signed Tree Head.

methods.name: VerifiesValidEmptySTH
methods.description: Checks verification of an empty but valid Signed Tree Head.

methods.name: DoesNotVerifyInvalidEmptySTH
methods.description: Checks that verification fails for a malformed empty Signed Tree Head.

methods.name: ExcessDataInPublicKey
methods.description: Tests rejection of a public key with extra data.

methods.name: VerifiesConsistencyProofEdgeCases_EmptyProof
methods.description: Tests edge cases for empty consistency proofs.

methods.name: VerifiesConsistencyProofEdgeCases_MismatchingRoots
methods.description: Tests rejection of proofs with mismatched roots.

methods.name: VerifiesConsistencyProofEdgeCases_MatchingRootsNonEmptyProof
methods.description: Tests edge cases where roots match but proof is invalid.

methods.name: VerifiesValidConsistencyProof
methods.description: Verifies that known good consistency proofs pass.

methods.name: VerifiesValidAuditProofs
methods.description: Verifies that known good audit proofs pass.

methods.name: VerifiesAuditProofEdgeCases_InvalidLeafIndex
methods.description: Checks verification failure for invalid leaf indices.

methods.name: HashLeaf
methods.description: Computes the hash of a leaf per RFC6962.

methods.name: HashTree
methods.description: Computes the Merkle root hash for a set of leaves.

methods.name: CreateAuditProof
methods.description: Generates a Merkle audit proof for a leaf.

methods.name: CreateConsistencyProof
methods.description: Generates a Merkle consistency proof between two trees.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies a SignedCertificateTimestamp.

methods.name: VerifySignedTreeHead
methods.description: Verifies a Signed Tree Head.
